Maricopa County, AZ
Apply for your permit . Log into Permit Center Account Permits: Residential Rooftop Solar: SolarAPP+ Click Apply. Include your approved set of documents and your SolarAPP approval number to proceed.
SolarAPP+ is a third-party software program that can be used to verify code compliance for residential photovoltaic (PV) projects. Maricopa County Planning and Development department (PND) will accept SolarAPP+ approved designs for application and permitting of residential photovoltaic projects for unincorporated Maricopa County.
